_comment: The web-coverage jobs are commented out in ci.yml. This file is descriptive only (GitHub does not consume it directly); apply changes via Repo Settings → Branches → Branch protection rules. Each entry is a GitHub Actions job-name string intended to be required before a PR can merge.
rationale: The web-coverage shard, merge, and gate jobs are commented out in .github/workflows/ci.yml, so their check names are no longer listed as required here.
